An ENHANCED RISK including the threat of EF2 tornadoes has been added to central and northern Oklahoma from OKC Metro north!

We are expected the usual I-44 ripper mode but a greater number if supercells across northern Oklahoma.

Team Dominator is activating live storm chase https://t.co/6qw0oO4hl9
Chasing a #tornado warned supercell with likely tornado in progress northeast of Bard, New Mexico near the Texas border https://t.co/Qev4foqjaB

Live emergency update targeting a NOCTURNAL #TORNADO THREAT about to begin in eastern New Mexico into the Texas Panhandle including Tucumcari to Amarillo. A tornado watch is coming soon! https://t.co/9iRiuuXkjk

LIMITED EDiTION DOMINATOR 3 MODELS have been launched in support of our science mission!

These are working models with spinning anemometer and armor deployment. They are a perfect gift for any weather enthusiast!

You can get yours at https://t.co/U1wv6bXueu https://t.co/RCjwYFJLv2

Melbourne, Florida woke up to yards and streets under water, and the rain still hasn't stopped.

Photos: Table for the Moreno's https://t.co/OpHvfn4F4i
The tornado risk just went up for Oklahoma City, Tulsa and southern Kansas today, and the threat picks up after about 6 PM Central. https://t.co/NJzQi6PzoL
Palm Bay, Florida has had more than 10 inches of rain since last night, and it's still coming down. https://t.co/Kv8Dw3QVRf

Flash Flood Emergency for West Melbourne and Palm Bay, FL right now. Eight to twelve inches of rain have already fallen with more coming, so move to higher ground immediately and stay off flooded roads, most flood deaths happen in cars. https://t.co/eBwsXrRLts
The nicest weather in the USA today will be in and around Las Vegas, NV, Yuma, AZ, and Lake Havasu City, AZ. https://t.co/UuccjvdDTj

MAJOR flooding is ongoing across Palm Bay, Florida, with nearly 20 INCHES of rain having fallen in some areas over the last 12 hours!

 A Flash Flood Emergency is in effect in these areas. Do NOT attempt to travel unless fleeing flooding or under an evacuation order!

📷Kelly https://t.co/x0giBDVAfZ

Parts of Florida’s Space Coast have now picked up over a FOOT of rain since midnight, with nearly 17 inches near Malabar, and it’s STILL coming down...

A strong high to the north is pushing ocean air straight into the Space Coast, loaded with about 2 inches of moisture, way https://t.co/MMCa2FBJ4a
Several tornadoes are possible today between Wichita and Oklahoma City, and some could be strong if supercells can hold together into early this evening! https://t.co/avFZlTZtMC

Nearly 10 inches of rain has fallen in parts of Palm Bay, Florida since midnight, and it’s STILL coming down hard...

Melbourne’s airport has measured 6.4 inches so far, already its wettest November day on record. A Flash Flood Emergency is in effect for Palm Bay and West https://t.co/AKyNeH1TlP

SEVERAL TORNADOES, some possibly strong, and damaging winds will target north-central Oklahoma and south-central Kansas today, now upgraded to an Enhanced Risk...

Morning showers will clear out of western Kansas and Oklahoma, letting temperatures climb into the 70s and low 80s https://t.co/sSE92Uc7Hm

Our research efforts continue and we have a ton of projects in the works for the next few months.

The premium subscription which we are adding soon will help support our research efforts while we keep the most critical info (short range data & daily forecasts) free.

There are several other new features and enhancements as well that are now live on the website and on the mobile app (iOS and Android).

Read more here https://t.co/vF3i4IjXqW https://t.co/ANbfkkqwDf
